article.story: NEW HAVEN, Conn. -- — Trevor Mullin scored 16 points as Yale beat Emmanuel of Massachusetts 103-58 on Sunday. Mullin also added five assists for the Bulldogs (2-3). Daniel Ogunyemi added 14 points while shooting 6 of 8 from the field and 2 for 3 from the line while they also had seven rebounds. Riley Fox shot 3 of 8 from the field, including 2 for 5 from 3-point range, and went 1 for 3 from the line to finish with nine points. Mahari Guerrier finished with 10 points for the Saints. Cameron Snowden added 10 points for Emmanuel. Up next Yale hosts Vermont in its next matchup on Wednesday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
